title: Coral Reef Bleaching Temperature Simulation
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js (via CDN) that simulates coral reef bleaching as ocean temperature rises. The simulation must be scientifically grounded: corals expel symbiotic algae (zooxanthellae) when water temperature exceeds stress thresholds, causing bleaching and eventually death.

SCENE SETUP:
- Dark blue-green background (color 0x0a2a3a) representing deep ocean.
- A PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 8, 18) looking at origin. OrbitControls enabled.
- Ambient light (0x4488aa, intensity 0.4) and a directional light (0xffffff, intensity 0.8) from (5, 10, 5).
- A sandy ocean floor: a PlaneGeometry(30, 30) with MeshStandardMaterial color 0xc2a366, rotated flat at y=0.
- Generate exactly 12 coral objects arranged in a 4x3 grid pattern (x from -6 to 6, z from -4 to 4, spacing ~4 units). Each coral is a group of 3-5 CylinderGeometry branches (radius 0.15-0.4, height 1-3) with random slight rotations to look organic. Each coral has a unique id (coral_0 through coral_11).
- Each coral starts with a healthy color of HSL(0.05, 0.9, 0.45) — a vibrant warm orange-brown representing zooxanthellae presence.
- Add subtle particle system: 200 small blue-white spheres (radius 0.03) drifting slowly upward to simulate water caustics/bubbles.

TEMPERATURE MODEL:
- Global ocean temperature starts at 26.0°C (healthy baseline).
- Temperature range: 20.0°C to 35.0°C.
- Bleaching threshold: 29.0°C — above this, corals begin losing color.
- Death threshold: 32.0°C — above this, corals begin dying.
- Each coral has individual properties: health (0.0 to 1.0, starts at 1.0), bleachLevel (0.0 to 1.0, starts at 0.0), isDead (boolean, starts false).
- When temperature > 29.0°C, each coral's bleachLevel increases by (temperature - 29.0) * 0.008 per animation frame (capped at 1.0). Health decreases proportionally.
- When temperature > 32.0°C, health decreases by an additional (temperature - 32.0) * 0.005 per frame. When health reaches 0, isDead becomes true.
- When temperature <= 29.0°C and coral is NOT dead, bleachLevel decreases by 0.003 per frame (recovery). Health increases by 0.002 per frame (capped at 1.0).
- Dead corals do NOT recover.
- Coral color interpolates: healthy color HSL(0.05, 0.9, 0.45) → bleached white HSL(0.0, 0.0, 0.9) based on bleachLevel. Dead corals turn dark gray HSL(0.0, 0.0, 0.3).

USER INTERACTIONS:
- ArrowUp key: increase temperature by 0.5°C (clamped to max 35.0).
- ArrowDown key: decrease temperature by 0.5°C (clamped to min 20.0).
- A 'Reset' button (DOM, id='resetBtn') that resets temperature to 26.0, all corals to full health, bleachLevel 0, isDead false, and restores original colors.
- A 'Toggle Simulation' button (DOM, id='toggleBtn') that pauses/resumes the bleaching simulation loop. Text shows 'Pause' when running, 'Resume' when paused.
- Clicking on a coral in the 3D scene (via Raycaster) selects it and displays its individual stats in the HUD. The selected coral gets a yellow wireframe outline (EdgesGeometry + LineBasicMaterial).

HUD / UI:
- Top-left panel (id='hud') with semi-transparent dark background showing:
  - Current temperature (id='tempDisplay'), format: 'Temperature: XX.X°C'
  - Simulation status (id='simStatus'): 'Status: Running' or 'Status: Paused'
  - Healthy coral count (id='healthyCount'): corals with health > 0.7
  - Bleaching coral count (id='bleachingCount'): corals with bleachLevel > 0.3 and not dead
  - Dead coral count (id='deadCount')
- Bottom panel (id='coralInfo') showing selected coral info: id, health (2 decimal places), bleachLevel (2 decimal places), isDead.
- A color-coded temperature bar (id='tempBar') — a horizontal gradient bar (green at 20°C, yellow at 29°C, red at 35°C) with a marker showing current temperature position.

STATE MANAGEMENT — window.__3D_STATE__ must expose:
- temperature: current float value
- simulationRunning: boolean
- corals: array of 12 objects each with {id, health, bleachLevel, isDead}
- selectedCoralIndex: number or null
- healthyCount: integer
- bleachingCount: integer
- deadCount: integer
- totalBleachLevel: sum of all coral bleachLevels (float)
- frameCount: integer incremented each animation frame
- particleCount: number of active bubble particles

ANIMATION:
- Corals gently sway (small sinusoidal rotation on branches) regardless of simulation state.
- Bubble particles drift upward and reset to bottom when reaching y > 10.
- Update __3D_STATE__ every frame.

Ensure all numerical state values are never NaN. Use requestAnimationFrame for the render loop.
physics_constraints: Temperature-dependent bleaching: bleachLevel increases at rate (T-29)*0.008/frame when T>29°C, health decreases proportionally. Death occurs at health=0 when T>32°C. Recovery at rate 0.003/frame bleach decrease when T<=29°C and not dead. Dead corals never recover. All values clamped [0,1]. Temperature clamped [20,35]. Conservation: totalBleachLevel = sum of all individual bleachLevels. Counts must be consistent with coral states.
